usage: A 床頭燈 is a noun referring to a lamp placed near the bed.
You can say '我嘅床頭燈壞咗' to mean 'My bedside lamp is broken.'
Use 床頭燈 when talking about lighting used for reading or relaxing in bed.
You can describe the color or brightness of the 床頭燈, e.g., '藍色嘅床頭燈' means 'blue bedside lamp.'
It usually appears as the subject or object in a sentence, like '我要買個新嘅床頭燈' (I want to buy a new bedside lamp).
